label: HB formation 10ns, guidance recovery vs short-MD covered length with 6 history statistics (experiment-D definition), strong base (K06b)

length_definition.unit: covered length (ns), same definition as L01/L02; prefix = frames 0..(L/0.1) of the 0-1 ns history, 100 ps spacing
length_definition.note: Differs from the G-series naming at 1.0 ns: G145's '1.0 ns' prefix is frames [0..9], while L01/L02/L39's covered 1.0 ns is frames [0..10].

statistics6_definition.source: MolCasta-InternalResearch branch research/fixed-1ns-3phen-6h-20261121, GPT playground/ATLAS-observed-2026-11-19/fixed_1ns_history_3phen_6h.py, features_from_history(series, bound)
statistics6_definition.threshold_source: THRESH['hb'] = 3.5 in the same script (HB formation boundary)
statistics6_definition.application_to_prefix: the same formula applied to the prefix sub-series frames 0..k; 'last' is the last frame of the prefix and the fraction is taken within the prefix
statistics6_definition.relation_to_k06b_history10: K06(b)'s 10 history features are [first, mean, std, min, max, last-first, last-prev, frac<=3.5A, frac<=4.5A, frac increasing], recomputed from the g05 series and verified against the stored k06b_out history for all 108 proteins x 3 replicas (see premise history_stats_check). The experiment-D 6 statistics are the subset at positions [0,1,2,3,5,7]; the 10 are the 6 plus [max, last-prev, frac<=4.5A, frac increasing]. Full history (10 stats on all 11 frames) is therefore a superset of the covered-1.0 ns 6-stats condition.

base.name: K06(b) strong base: frozen T1I2006 + HistGBM sidecar (160 iters, lr 0.065, 15 leaves, min_samples_leaf 20, L2 0.15, seed 20261121), trained on 8 calibration proteins, evaluated on 100 unseen proteins x 3 replicas

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (100 test proteins, resampled with replacement)
bootstrap.note: Same procedure as L02. Within each resample, static-only, full-history and each prefix condition's AUPRCs are recomputed and the gain and recovery are recomputed inside the sample. Models are not refit. Both families (mean-only and 6-stats) are bootstrapped from the same draws. Pooled AUPRC uses a numpy implementation of sklearn's average_precision_score (threshold-grouped), verified against sklearn to <1e-9 on the full test set for every condition. Macro AUPRC within a resample is the multiplicity-weighted mean of per-protein AUPRCs over proteins whose AUPRC is defined.
